planets.name: WASP-41 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-41 with a 3.05-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: WASP-41 b was found in 2011 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around WASP-41. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
